page_title: ESP 0-0 OSA | Espanyol v Osasuna 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Alex Kral (Espanyol) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

90+6' That didn't go as planned! Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Sergio Herrera, who easily kept it out.
90+6' Kike Barja (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
90+6' Kike Barja (Osasuna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+3' Kike Barja (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
90+3' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+2' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
87' Substitution. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) has come on for Abel Bretones.
86' Kike Barja (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aimar Oroz.
86' Substitution. Carlos Romero leaves the pitch and is replaced by Justin Smith (Espanyol).
83' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) replaces Jesus Areso.
81' Espanyol win a corner.
80' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Adrian Cordero who sees an offensive foul.
78' The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.

77' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out for a corner. Espanyol can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Now Espanyol have a corner.
76' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
76' The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
75' The attendance is 20513.

74' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
73' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) picks up an injury.
71' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
69' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
67' Substitution. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) on for Raul Garcia.
67' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
66' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Adrian Cordero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' That will be all from Antoniu Roca who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).
58' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
52' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
52' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Osasuna get a corner.
50' A poor finish by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
50' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Referee Adrian Cordero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
41' Looks like Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
36' Espanyol are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes.
32' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
31' The yellow card goes to Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
28' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Adrian Cordero saw the whole situation.
28' Adrian Cordero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
28' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:0.

24' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
22' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
20' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 42:58.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Osasuna.

12' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna. An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Irvin Cardona (Espanyol), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
11' The Osasuna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Alex Kral (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Neat passing move from Osasuna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
3' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
